## maven-3.9.2
[Release Notes - Maven - Version 3.9.2](https://maven.apache.org/docs/3.9.2/release-notes.html)
--

Bug
---

*   \[[MNG-7750](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7750)\] - Interpolated properties in originalModel in an active profile.
*   \[[MNG-7759](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7759)\] - java.lang.NullPointerException at org.apache.maven.repository.internal.DefaultModelCache.newInstance (DefaultModelCache.java:37)

Improvement
-----------

*   \[[MNG-7712](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7712)\] - Core should issue a warning if plugin depends on maven-compat
*   \[[MNG-7741](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7741)\] - Add more information when using -Dmaven.repo.local.recordReverseTree=true
*   \[[MNG-7754](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7754)\] - Improvement and extension of plugin validation
*   \[[MNG-7767](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7767)\] - Tone down plugin validation report
*   \[[MNG-7778](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7778)\] - Maven should print suppressed exceptions when a mojo fails

Task
----

*   \[[MNG-7749](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7749)\] - Upgrade animal-sniffer from 1.21 to 1.23
*   \[[MNG-7774](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7774)\] - Maven config and command line interpolation

Dependency upgrade
------------------

*   \[[MNG-7670](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7670)\] - Upgrade misc dependencies
*   \[[MNG-7753](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7753)\] - Upgrade to Maven Resolver 1.9.8
*   \[[MNG-7769](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7769)\] - Upgrade to Maven Resolver 1.9.10

## maven-3.9.3
[Release Notes - Maven - Version 3.9.3](https://maven.apache.org/docs/3.9.3/release-notes.html)
---

Bug
---

*   \[[MNG-7786](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7786)\] - Maven Plugin Validation message is misleading
*   \[[MNG-7795](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7795)\] - IllegalArgumentException: 'other' has different root during plugin validation
*   \[[MNG-7796](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7796)\] - Top directory cannot be computed
*   \[[MNG-7799](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7799)\] - Plugin validation falsely reports there are issues (but shows none)
*   \[[MNG-7811](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7811)\] - Plugins verification - reports are inconsistent
*   \[[MNG-7818](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7818)\] - \[REGRESSION\] maven improperly excludes hamcrest-core from junit
*   \[[MNG-7819](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7819)\] - Create IT that exercise file locking with snapshots

Improvement
-----------

*   \[[MNG-7698](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7698)\] - Allow comments in .mvn/maven.config
*   \[[MNG-7785](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7785)\] - Clean usage of SessionData
*   \[[MNG-7787](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7787)\] - Introduce new options for plugin validation
*   \[[MNG-7788](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7788)\] - Plugin Validation Report should be printed before build summary
*   \[[MNG-7789](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7789)\] - Plugin Dependency Validations use wrong data set
*   \[[MNG-7806](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7806)\] - Plugins verification - remove used in module(s) report
*   \[[MNG-7823](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7823)\] - Make plugin validation level parsing more consistent

Task
----

*   \[[MNG-5987](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-5987)\] - Document the algorithm calculating the order of plugin executions inside a phase.
*   \[[MNG-7743](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7743)\] - Make the build work on JDK 20
*   \[[MNG-7790](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7790)\] - Update lifecycle plugins
*   \[[MNG-7791](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7791)\] - Split validation issues into "user actionable" and "plugin dev actionable"
*   \[[MNG-7797](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7797)\] - Return BRIEF mode, simply map it onto SUMMARY
*   \[[MNG-7807](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7807)\] - Update Super POM plugins

Dependency upgrade
------------------

*   \[[MNG-7800](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7800)\] - Upgrade to Maven Resolver 1.9.13
*   \[[MNG-7816](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-7816)\] - Bump maven parent from 39 to 40
